decision: Do not start broad PMXT/Polymarket L2 backfill. The current code proves a bounded one-off selected-source path and records several fail-fast guardrails, but broad backfill still lacks accepted source proof, accepted expanded coverage/cost/storage evidence, and a dynamic tick-size replay or bounded-exclusion policy.

root_cause.previous_slow_backfill_failure_mode: Large hourly PMXT Parquet objects were treated as payloads to scan, hash, or stage before the acceptance gates proved a bounded source/window/instrument scope.
why_repeating_it_is_unsafe: PMXT v2 hourly objects are hundreds of MB and can contain tens of millions of rows, so full-object work scales poorly across broad windows.
The accepted source proof is still pending; payload work before source acceptance can produce expensive artifacts that cannot become canonical.
Standard pinned NT BacktestNode catalog replay does not currently expose timed InstrumentAny instrument-definition replay, so full L2 over tick-size-changing assets would overclaim correctness.
root_cause.current_bounded_improvement: The current one-off selector path records source_row_groups in the event-count ledger and selector report, then selected_source_slice projects only the selector row groups with ParquetRecordBatchReaderBuilder.with_row_groups.
root_cause.remaining_efficiency_gap: The one-off selected-source stage still computes source_parquet_sha256 by reading the full source file, and first_proof_event_count_ledger still performs a full two-column scan of the accepted one-hour source object. That is acceptable for a bounded proof, not for broad backfill.

polymarket_official_api.observed_2026_06_09: Official Polymarket APIs include Gamma, Data, and CLOB. Gamma/Data are public; CLOB has public orderbook/pricing endpoints and trading endpoints that require authentication.
polymarket_official_api.historical_l2_limit: The official prices-history endpoint returns price history with t/p pairs and minute fidelity, not full historical L2 order book replay.

pmxt_archive.observed_2026_06_09: PMXT v2 is an hourly Parquet archive of Polymarket CLOB market WebSocket events from every live asset.
pmxt_archive.current_index_sample: 2026-06-08 hourly objects listed around 451.5 MB to 603.6 MB.
pmxt_archive.license: CC BY 4.0 with attribution per PMXT docs

local_sources.evidence: PolymarketDataClient is a live market data client: it handles WebSocket book snapshots, price_change deltas, last_trade_price TradeTicks, tick_size_change instrument rebuilds, and Gamma instrument discovery.
PolymarketDataApiHttpClient fetches public historical trades and converts them to TradeTick, with an offset ceiling warning; it is not a full historical L2 order book archive reader.
Pinned NT live Polymarket emits rebuilt instruments for tick-size changes, but standard BacktestNode catalog replay does not expose timed InstrumentAny replay.

nt_surface_evidence.current_split: Use NT for model types, Polymarket parser/provider surfaces, ParquetDataCatalog, and BacktestNode. Keep Bolt-owned code limited to source-proof gating, artifact provenance, and raw historical source adapters where NT has no batch source reader.

bounded_row_group_projection.evidence: selector_source_row_groups requires selected_assets[].source_row_groups, validates bounds against Parquet metadata, and selected_source_slice builds the reader with with_row_groups(matching_row_groups.row_groups).
selected_source_slice_uses_selector_row_groups_without_full_asset_rescan proves the selected-source stage succeeds when the non-selected row group contains an unscannable null asset value.
The refreshed one-off report records source_row_groups=62, projected_row_groups=1, selected_rows=5, selected_asset_count=1.

bounded_full_object_work.evidence: build_first_proof_event_count_ledger_from_parquet projects only asset_id and event_family columns but reads all row groups to build event counts and source_row_groups.
write_selected_source_slice computes source_parquet_sha256 with sha256_file before row-group projection, which reads the full source file.

no_download_coverage_gate.evidence: The committed coverage ledger status proves source-proof metadata and coverage_axis can be derived without payload download, but both PMXT records remain rejected because source_proof_status is pending.

required_before_any_broad_backfill: Accept a durable Polymarket SourceProofReport for the exact source/window/table_family.
Keep the first gate manifest/index-only: coverage, freshness, completeness, bytes, object count, and cost must be recorded before payload download.
Replace broad full-object hashing in planning/projection with accepted object hashes from staging or Artifact Index records; full payload reads belong only inside bounded accepted tranches.
Carry object-level row-group or predicate metadata from the accepted source proof into the execution plan so selected-source projection does not rediscover it by rescanning payloads.
Set explicit object byte, row count, projected row-group count, and wall-time budgets in the accepted tranche plan.
Prove dynamic tick-size replay through NT BacktestNode/catalog, or accept a source-proof-bound no-tick-size-change exclusion policy before full L2 replay claims.
Use GitHub CI as the broad verification gate for committed changes; avoid broad local cargo test runs as the default verification path.
claim_limits: This artifact does not accept PMXT as a durable source.
This artifact does not authorize broad PMXT/Polymarket backfill.
This artifact does not prove expanded coverage, exact broad cost, or production throughput.
This artifact does not prove dynamic tick-size replay.
